# @gears-frontx/ui-kit

> Standard React component base for FrontX templates. Behavior comes from
> Base UI primitives, styling is compiled CSS on semantic design tokens,
> variants via cva-driven props — `variant` for the paint/kind axis and
> `size` for the scale one, plus the occasional extra axis where a component
> genuinely has one (Table's `density`, AvatarFallback/AvatarGroupCount's
> `tone`). Consumers need no CSS framework
> or build plugins.

Rules for generated code:

- Import the design tokens exactly once at the app entry:
  `import '@gears-frontx/ui-kit/theme.css';`
- Two more global stylesheets ship alongside it, each imported at the app
  entry only when needed — neither is pulled in by any component's own CSS
  chunk, so a missing import fails silently:
  `import '@gears-frontx/ui-kit/utilities.css';` supplies the `shimmer`,
  `scroll-fade-x` and `no-scrollbar` classes. Attachment DEPENDS on it
  (`AttachmentTitle` shimmers while uploading, `AttachmentGroup` scrolls
  its row with the other two) and Marker pairs with `shimmer` for
  streaming text — without it those components render, minus the effect.
  `import '@gears-frontx/ui-kit/typeset.css';` styles rendered markdown/
  HTML the app does not author (chat messages, docs, CMS content): wrap it
  in `<div class="typeset">`, optionally with a rhythm preset — see
  [Typeset](dist/docs/typeset.md).
- Import components from the package root: `import { Button } from '@gears-frontx/ui-kit';`
  Each component ships its own CSS, pulled in automatically by importing the
  component — there is no separate stylesheet import for component styles.
  A component subpath also works (`import { Button } from '@gears-frontx/ui-kit/button';`)
  and is the one to reach for on an esbuild-based build specifically: esbuild
  tree-shakes unused components' JS from a root import already, but only
  drops their CSS from a subpath import — Vite and webpack drop both either
  way, so this only matters when esbuild is the actual bundler running.
- Icons are `lucide-react` components, imported directly at the use site
  (`import { ChevronDownIcon } from 'lucide-react';`). The kit depends on
  `lucide-react` itself, so it resolves without a separate install, and it is
  also what to pass into any `icon` slot prop. Kit CSS sizes icons through
  each part's own `svg` rule, so a plain `<SomeIcon />` picks up the right
  size; pass `className`/`size` only to override it.
- In an RSC framework (Next.js App Router), a component is safe to import
  and render directly from a Server Component — no wrapping
  client-boundary module needed — unless it appears in the next line. The
  kit components that carry a `'use client'` banner of their own:
  Attachment, Badge, Breadcrumb, Bubble, ButtonGroup, Carousel, Chart,
  Combobox, ContextMenu, DataTable, Drawer, DropdownMenu, Marker, Sidebar,
  Toast. Each calls a hook directly in its own render body, so it always
  renders on the client, wherever it is imported from.
- The kit paints the page itself from its tokens and sets `color-scheme`: with
  no `data-theme` attribute anywhere, `prefers-color-scheme: dark` alone
  yields a correct, legible dark page (background, text, and UA-owned
  surfaces like the scrollbar) out of the box — no setup step required for
  that case.
- Fonts come from the kit's own tokens: `--font-sans` (Inter, then system
  fallbacks) is set on the page by theme.css, `--font-mono` (JetBrains
  Mono) is for code-like text. The kit ships no font FILES — load Inter/
  JetBrains Mono in the app for the true Studio look (the fallbacks stay
  legible without them), or override the tokens to rebrand.
- Font overrides AND, for explicit control instead of following the OS
  preference, `data-theme` go on `<html>`/`<body>`, not on an inner
  container: overlay components (Select, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Tooltip,
  Toaster) portal their popup to `<body>` and inherit theme tokens and
  font from there. A
  `data-theme` subtree (anywhere, not just `<html>`/`<body>`) paints its own
  surface, not just its descendants' tokens, so it can be nested inside a
  page carrying the opposite theme. If a subtree must carry its own theme,
  pass that element as `container` to `SelectContent` / `DialogContent` /
  `DropdownMenuContent` / `TooltipContent` / `Toaster`.
- Brand/appearance changes go through theme tokens (CSS variables in
  `theme.css`, light/dark via `data-theme`), never through inline styles or
  overriding kit class names.
- Rounding is a scale derived from `--radius` (`--radius-xs|sm|md|lg|xl`);
  override `--radius` alone and every component follows.
- Page typography uses the Studio type ramp tokens:
  `--text-<role>-size|line-height|weight|tracking` for roles
  display|heading-1|heading-2|body|label|meta|mono (e.g. a page title is
  `font-size: var(--text-heading-1-size)` etc.; medium-weight body text is
  the body role at `font-weight: 500`). Use the ramp for template text
  instead of inventing sizes — kit components already sit on it.
- Per-component docs below list the kit-level props; everything else is the
  underlying native element's props.

## Components

- [Accordion](dist/docs/accordion.md): vertically stacked headers that
  expand to reveal content (Accordion/AccordionItem/AccordionTrigger/
  AccordionContent); wraps Base UI Accordion; single-item expansion by
  default, `multiple` allows more than one open; height-animated panel.
- [Alert](dist/docs/alert.md): page-level banner callout
  (Alert/AlertTitle/AlertDescription/AlertAction); variant
  default|destructive; no Base UI primitive, `role="alert"`; a leading
  `<svg>` child switches to a two-column icon layout, detected
  structurally.
- [AlertDialog](dist/docs/alert-dialog.md): modal confirmation the user
  must explicitly acknowledge (AlertDialog/AlertDialogTrigger/
  AlertDialogContent/AlertDialogHeader/AlertDialogFooter/
  AlertDialogAction/AlertDialogCancel); unlike `Dialog`, never closes on
  outside press; `AlertDialogContent` size default|sm (sm stacks the two
  actions into columns).
- [AspectRatio](dist/docs/aspect-ratio.md): constrains a child to a fixed
  width/height ratio via CSS `aspect-ratio`; `ratio` prop only, no Base UI
  primitive, no variants; reserves the box, does not crop its content.
- [Attachment](dist/docs/attachment.md): file/image attachment card for
  chat composers and message threads (Attachment/AttachmentMedia/
  AttachmentContent/AttachmentActions/AttachmentTrigger, AttachmentGroup);
  upload-state axis drives the `shimmer` utility automatically via
  context; no Base UI primitive.
- [Avatar](dist/docs/avatar.md): profile picture with a loading fallback
  (Avatar/AvatarImage/AvatarFallback/AvatarBadge, AvatarGroup+
  AvatarGroupCount); sizes sm|default|lg; wraps the Base UI Avatar
  primitive for image/fallback timing. AvatarFallback and AvatarGroupCount
  share one fill matrix — `tone` neutral|accent|info|success|warning|danger
  crossed with `variant` solid|soft (default neutral/soft, matching
  upstream's single look byte for byte) — so a "+N" chip can match the toned
  members it caps; `tone` is identity styling (derive it from who the
  avatar is, e.g. a hash of the user id), never a live state — use
  `AvatarBadge` for that. AvatarGroupCount takes no `size`; it reads its
  size off its sibling Avatars' `size` within the same AvatarGroup.
- [Badge](dist/docs/badge.md): compact inline label; variants
  default|secondary|destructive|outline|ghost|link|success|warning|danger|info|accent
  (paint only — no semantic-state axis), two groups on one axis: six
  upstream paints (same names/meaning as Button's) plus five tones — a
  soft tinted fill with the tone's own color as the label (`secondary`
  doubles as the tone row's Neutral, so there is no separate `neutral`
  name); a tone still paints, it does not track state — don't let color
  alone carry the meaning, keep the label text itself explicit; no Base
  UI primitive, but gets `render`-prop polymorphism via
  `useRender`/`mergeProps` (e.g. `<a>`) for a badge that is actually a
  link.
- [Breadcrumb](dist/docs/breadcrumb.md): ancestor trail ending in the
  current page (Breadcrumb/BreadcrumbList/BreadcrumbItem/BreadcrumbLink/
  BreadcrumbPage/BreadcrumbSeparator/BreadcrumbEllipsis); no Base UI
  primitive; `BreadcrumbLink` gets `render`-prop polymorphism for routing
  through a consumer's own link component.
- [Bubble](dist/docs/bubble.md): framed chat-message surface
  (Bubble/BubbleContent/BubbleReactions, BubbleGroup); variants
  default|secondary|muted|tinted|outline|ghost|destructive; `align`
  start|end both positions the bubble and squares its speaker-side top
  corner (the shape cue that separates a message from a button; `ghost`
  has no frame and no notch); scoped to the message surface only — pair
  with `Message` for the full row.
- [Button](dist/docs/button.md): action button; variants
  default|destructive|outline|secondary|ghost|link, sizes default|sm|lg; a
  consumer className can recolor a button in every state via
  `--button-bg`/`--button-fg`/`--button-bg-hover`/`--button-fg-hover`/
  `--button-border` — no new variant needed; icons go in the `icon` slot
  prop, NEVER in children — `icon` with no children makes a square
  icon-only button (always pass `aria-label` then); `loading` spins,
  disables, and keeps the width and accessible name; render prop for
  button-semantic actions over a real anchor (not a link substitute);
  `buttonVariants` is exported for styling other elements to match.
- [ButtonGroup](dist/docs/button-group.md): visually joins a row/column of
  controls into one strip (ButtonGroup/ButtonGroupText/
  ButtonGroupSeparator); orientation horizontal|vertical; works on any
  direct child, not just buttons.
- [Calendar](dist/docs/calendar.md): month grid for picking a day or
  range, wrapping react-day-picker; every `DayPicker` prop passes through;
  `captionLayout` label|dropdown|dropdown-months|dropdown-years;
  `DatePicker` composes this behind a trigger.
- [Card](dist/docs/card.md): bounded content surface (Card/CardHeader/
  CardTitle/CardDescription/CardAction/CardContent/CardFooter); header
  becomes a two-column/two-row grid automatically when it contains a
  CardAction/CardDescription; sizes default|sm.
- [Carousel](dist/docs/carousel.md): embla-carousel-react scroll-snapping
  slide track (Carousel/CarouselContent/CarouselItem/CarouselPrevious/
  CarouselNext); orientation horizontal|vertical; `useCarousel()` exported
  for custom controls; no Base UI primitive.
- [Chart](dist/docs/chart.md): themeable Recharts wrapper
  (ChartContainer/ChartTooltip+ChartTooltipContent/ChartLegend+
  ChartLegendContent); draws no chart type itself — series colors come
  from a per-instance `ChartConfig`, not `--chart-*` tokens; no
  variant/size axis.
- [Checkbox](dist/docs/checkbox.md): on/off tick box for independent
  options; `checked`/`onCheckedChange`; nest inside Label for one click
  target.
- [Collapsible](dist/docs/collapsible.md): single expandable/collapsible
  section (Collapsible/CollapsibleTrigger/CollapsibleContent); no
  variants; unmounts while closed unless `keepMounted`; height-animates
  via Base UI's measured panel height.
- [Combobox](dist/docs/combobox.md): filterable text field picking from a
  list, wrapping Base UI's dedicated Combobox primitive (not a
  Popover+search composition); single-select (ComboboxInput) or
  multi-select chips (ComboboxChips+ComboboxChip); always pass `items`.
- [Command](dist/docs/command.md): searchable, keyboard-navigable
  command/option list built on `cmdk` (Command/CommandInput/CommandList/
  CommandGroup/CommandItem/CommandSeparator); `CommandDialog` composes the
  kit's own `Dialog`, not cmdk's bundled dialog.
- [ContextMenu](dist/docs/context-menu.md): right-click/long-press action
  menu (ContextMenu/ContextMenuTrigger/ContextMenuContent + the same
  item/checkbox/radio/submenu parts as DropdownMenu); always modal, no
  hover-open; opens at the pointer position.
- [DataTable](dist/docs/data-table.md): sortable, paginated, optionally
  row-selectable table built on `Table` + `@tanstack/react-table` v9;
  productizes upstream's data-table *guide* into a real component
  (`dataTableColumnHelper`, `dataTableSelectionColumn`,
  `DataTableSortButton`); no filtering/column-visibility/
  virtualization/resizing.
- [DatePicker](dist/docs/date-picker.md): field that opens a `Calendar` in
  a `Popover` to pick a day or range; productizes upstream's
  Popover+Calendar *recipe* into one component; mode single|range,
  variant button|input (single mode only).
- [Dialog](dist/docs/dialog.md): modal overlay for a focused task or
  confirmation (Dialog/DialogTrigger/DialogContent/DialogHeader/
  DialogFooter/DialogTitle/DialogDescription/DialogClose); traps focus,
  closes on Escape/outside click; `DialogContent` takes `container` and
  `showCloseButton`.
- [Direction](dist/docs/direction.md): thin re-export of Base UI's
  `DirectionProvider`/`useDirection`; no styling, no DOM element of its
  own; shares a reading direction (`ltr`|`rtl`) with every RTL-aware Base
  UI-backed kit component below it.
- [Drawer](dist/docs/drawer.md): edge-anchored panel dismissible by swipe
  gesture, wrapping Base UI's dedicated Drawer primitive (Drawer/
  DrawerTrigger/DrawerContent/DrawerHeader/DrawerFooter, optional
  DrawerSwipeHandle); `side` top|right|bottom|left; supports nested
  drawers and snap points.
- [DropdownMenu](dist/docs/dropdown-menu.md): actions/options anchored to
  a trigger (DropdownMenu/DropdownMenuTrigger/DropdownMenuContent/
  DropdownMenuItem/DropdownMenuCheckboxItem/DropdownMenuRadioGroup+
  DropdownMenuRadioItem/DropdownMenuSeparator/DropdownMenuShortcut/
  DropdownMenuSub+DropdownMenuSubTrigger+DropdownMenuSubContent); item
  variants default|destructive; `DropdownMenuContent` takes `container`.
- [Empty](dist/docs/empty.md): placeholder for a list/table/panel with
  nothing to show (Empty/EmptyHeader/EmptyMedia/EmptyTitle/
  EmptyDescription/EmptyContent); no Base UI primitive; `EmptyMedia`
  variant default|icon.
- [Field](dist/docs/field.md): primitive-free form-layout system
  (Field/FieldLabel/FieldDescription/FieldError/FieldGroup/FieldSet/
  FieldLegend/FieldSeparator/FieldContent/FieldTitle); Field's `orientation`
  is vertical|horizontal|responsive (responsive switches to horizontal at
  the `@container/field-group` mid breakpoint — wrap fields in
  `FieldGroup`); FieldLegend's `variant` is legend|label; no automatic id/
  htmlFor/aria-describedby wiring — wire `FieldLabel`'s `htmlFor` to the
  control's `id` yourself, same as upstream shadcn; `data-invalid`/
  `data-disabled` are plain attributes you set, not derived state.
- [HoverCard](dist/docs/hover-card.md): portalled preview panel opened on
  hover/focus (HoverCard/HoverCardTrigger/HoverCardContent), wrapping Base
  UI's PreviewCard primitives under the shadcn `hover-card` name; `delay`
  measures hover intent, not entry.
- [Input](dist/docs/input.md): single-line text field; `onValueChange`
  for the string value, `aria-invalid` for the error state; `icon` for a
  leading decorative icon, `end` for trailing interactive content (e.g. a
  clear button; rendered after the input, so tab order is field → slot) —
  neither renders automatically; `type="search"` gives the searchbox role
  but no icon by itself — pass one via `icon`; inside `Field`, wire
  `id`/`aria-describedby` by hand like every other control.
- [InputGroup](dist/docs/input-group.md): composes Input/Textarea with
  icon/text/button addons into one visually unified field (InputGroup/
  InputGroupAddon/InputGroupButton/InputGroupText/InputGroupInput/
  InputGroupTextarea); the group draws the border/focus/error ring, the
  wrapped control draws none of its own — focus is keyed to the control's
  `:focus-visible` (not any focus-within), error is `aria-invalid` on the
  control, and disabled is scoped to the field: a disabled
  `InputGroupButton` inside an addon dims only itself, not the group;
  `InputGroupAddon`'s `align` is inline-start|inline-end|block-start|
  block-end, composable on both axes at once; `InputGroupButton` size is
  xs|sm (default xs).
- [InputOtp](dist/docs/input-otp.md): one-time-passcode entry with paste/
  auto-advance/completion built in, on Base UI's OTPField primitive
  (InputOtp/InputOtpGroup/InputOtpSlot/InputOtpSeparator); `length`
  required; `validationType` numeric|alphanumeric|...; `mask` for
  password-style entry.
- [Item](dist/docs/item.md): a single row in a list of similar things
  (ItemGroup/Item/ItemMedia/ItemContent/ItemTitle/ItemDescription/
  ItemActions/ItemHeader/ItemFooter); `Item`'s `render` prop makes the
  whole row a link; variant default|outline|muted, size default|sm|xs.
- [Kbd](dist/docs/kbd.md): visual keyboard-key/shortcut representation
  (Kbd, KbdGroup); plain `<kbd>`, no interactive or ARIA behavior —
  decoration only.
- [Label](dist/docs/label.md): caption for a form control; native
  `<label>` props; associate via `htmlFor` or by nesting the control.
- [Marker](dist/docs/marker.md): inline conversation marker for status
  updates, system notes, and labeled separators (Marker/MarkerContent/
  MarkerIcon); variants incl. border|separator; pairs with the `shimmer`
  utility class for a streaming-text effect (opt-in, not automatic).
- [Menubar](dist/docs/menubar.md): horizontal row of menus like a desktop
  app's File/Edit/View bar (Menubar/MenubarMenu/MenubarTrigger + the same
  content parts as DropdownMenu); Base UI coordinates keyboard/hover
  switching between sibling menus.
- [Message](dist/docs/message.md): a conversation row owning avatar/
  alignment/header/footer layout (Message/MessageAvatar/MessageContent/
  MessageHeader/MessageFooter, MessageGroup); no Base UI primitive;
  render the visible surface inside it with `Bubble`.
- [MessageScroller](dist/docs/message-scroller.md): chat-transcript
  scroller with auto-follow-to-newest and a jump-back button
  (MessageScrollerProvider/MessageScroller/MessageScrollerViewport/
  MessageScrollerContent/MessageScrollerItem/MessageScrollerButton);
  behavior from `@shadcn/react/message-scroller` (approved non-Base-UI
  dependency), kit supplies styling only.
- [NativeSelect](dist/docs/native-select.md): a real `<select>` styled to
  match the kit's field chrome (NativeSelect/NativeSelectOption/
  NativeSelectOptGroup); no Base UI primitive; for platform-native
  pickers or no-JS/SSR fallback contexts.
- [NavigationMenu](dist/docs/navigation-menu.md): horizontal nav bar whose
  items expand into a rich dropdown panel (NavigationMenu/
  NavigationMenuList/NavigationMenuItem/NavigationMenuTrigger/
  NavigationMenuContent/NavigationMenuLink); one shared popup/Viewport
  morphs to each active item's measured size.
- [Pagination](dist/docs/pagination.md): page-number navigation from real
  anchors, styled through Button's own variant classes (Pagination/
  PaginationContent/PaginationItem/PaginationLink/PaginationPrevious/
  PaginationNext/PaginationEllipsis); `PaginationLink`'s `isActive`
  switches outline/ghost and sets `aria-current`.
- [Popover](dist/docs/popover.md): portalled panel anchored to a trigger,
  opened by click by default (Popover/PopoverTrigger/PopoverContent/
  PopoverHeader/PopoverTitle/PopoverDescription); non-modal by default —
  no focus trap, no backdrop; `PopoverTrigger`'s `openOnHover` opts into
  hover-open.
- [Progress](dist/docs/progress.md): completion bar (Progress/
  ProgressTrack/ProgressIndicator/ProgressLabel/ProgressValue); `value`
  required, `null` for indeterminate; reports `role="progressbar"` with
  `aria-valuenow`/min/max.
- [Questionnaire](dist/docs/questionnaire.md): single-item-at-a-time
  multi-step form with progress/required/skip/invalid state
  (Questionnaire/QuestionnaireItem/QuestionnaireChoices+
  QuestionnaireChoice/QuestionnaireInput/QuestionnaireActions); behavior
  from `@shadcn/react/questionnaire` (approved non-Base-UI dependency).
- [RadioGroup](dist/docs/radio-group.md): mutually exclusive options
  (RadioGroup + RadioGroupItem); `value`/`onValueChange` on the group;
  arrow-key navigation built in.
- [Resizable](dist/docs/resizable.md): react-resizable-panels wrapper for
  user-draggable split panes (ResizablePanelGroup/ResizablePanel/
  ResizableHandle); no Base UI primitive; nest groups for IDE-style
  multi-pane layouts.
- [ScrollArea](dist/docs/scroll-area.md): custom-styled scrollable
  container replacing the browser's native scrollbar (ScrollArea,
  ScrollBar); wraps Base UI ScrollArea for scroll physics/overflow
  detection/thumb drag; no variants; not for the page's own root scroll.
- [Select](dist/docs/select.md): dropdown picking one value from a
  list (Select/SelectTrigger/SelectValue/SelectContent/SelectGroup/
  SelectItem); trigger sizes default|sm, trigger variants default|filter
  (filter = compact toolbar filter chip, label stays muted); the popup
  always opens below the trigger (never overlays it), scrolling a selected
  item into view when it sits beyond the fold; keyboard and typeahead
  built in.
- [Separator](dist/docs/separator.md): thin visual divider between content
  sections; orientation horizontal|vertical (default horizontal); no
  `decorative` prop — pass `aria-hidden="true"` for a purely visual
  divider; not for use inside DropdownMenu/Select popups, which have their
  own separator styling; no portal.
- [Sheet](dist/docs/sheet.md): edge-anchored panel for a focused task/form
  without leaving the page (Sheet/SheetTrigger/SheetContent/SheetHeader/
  SheetFooter/SheetTitle/SheetDescription); wraps the same Base UI Dialog
  primitives as `Dialog`; `side` top|right|bottom|left; modal by default.
- [Sidebar](dist/docs/sidebar.md): composable app-shell sidebar with an
  expand/collapse state machine (SidebarProvider+useSidebar plus ~20
  layout parts); persists desktop open state in a cookie, toggles on
  Cmd/Ctrl+B, switches to a slide-in `Sheet` on mobile; built entirely
  from other kit parts.
- [Skeleton](dist/docs/skeleton.md): pulsing placeholder shape shown while
  content loads; no Base UI primitive, no variants — size it yourself via
  `className`/`style`; no ARIA of its own, put `role="status"`/`aria-busy`
  on the surrounding container; pulse animation is removed under
  `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`; no portal.
- [Slider](dist/docs/slider.md): draggable control for a number or range
  from a bounded scale (pointer drag/click-on-track/arrow-keys); `value`/
  `defaultValue`'s length determines the number of rendered thumbs;
  orientation horizontal|vertical.
- [Spinner](dist/docs/spinner.md): CSS-spun lucide `loader-circle`;
  no Base UI primitive, no variants; use `Button`'s own `loading` prop
  inside a button instead of nesting this.
- [Switch](dist/docs/switch.md): immediate on/off toggle;
  `checked`/`onCheckedChange`, sizes default|sm; use checkbox for
  submit-time options.
- [Table](dist/docs/table.md): styled native table markup
  (Table/TableHeader/TableBody/TableFooter/TableRow/TableHead/TableCell/
  TableCaption); no Base UI primitive, no sorting/filtering/pagination —
  primitive markup only; `density` compact|default on Table; row-state
  rings via `data-state="selected|stale|restricted"` on TableRow (your
  logic sets the attribute, the kit paints it); Table's own wrapper
  scrolls horizontally and is keyboard-reachable (`tabIndex`); size a
  column via `className`/`style` width on TableHead/TableCell; no portal.
- [Tabs](dist/docs/tabs.md): switch between panels sharing the same
  space (Tabs/TabsList/TabsTrigger/TabsContent); list variants
  default|line; orientation horizontal|vertical (default horizontal);
  inactive panels unmount unless `keepMounted`; no portal.
- [Textarea](dist/docs/textarea.md): multi-line text field; a plain styled
  native `<textarea>` — no primitive, no Field auto-wiring; native
  `<textarea>` props; grows with content; `aria-invalid` for the error
  state.
- [Toast](dist/docs/toast.md): brief transient notification stacked
  bottom-right; fired imperatively (`toast.add({...})`), not composed as
  JSX; mount `Toaster` once; type-driven icon
  success|info|warning|error|loading, optional action button; `Toaster`
  takes `container`.
- [Toggle](dist/docs/toggle.md): two-state on/off button (`pressed`/
  `defaultPressed`/`onPressedChange`); variant default|outline, size
  default|sm|lg; standalone or as an item inside `ToggleGroup`.
- [ToggleGroup](dist/docs/toggle-group.md): a set of related toggle
  buttons sharing pressed state (ToggleGroup/ToggleGroupItem); single- or
  multiple-selection via `multiple`, arrow-key navigation between items;
  item-level variant/size fall back to the group's.
- [Tooltip](dist/docs/tooltip.md): visual-only hint on hover/focus of a
  trigger (Tooltip/TooltipTrigger/TooltipContent); optional
  `TooltipProvider` shares delay/grouping across many tooltips;
  `TooltipContent` takes `container`; disabled on touch devices — never
  the only carrier of essential information.

## Stylesheets

- [Typeset](dist/docs/typeset.md): prose styling for rendered markdown/HTML
  (`typeset.css`); wrapper class `typeset` plus rhythm presets
  `typeset-chat|docs|reading|compact|large`, `not-typeset` to opt a subtree
  out, `typeset-scroll` for one wide block; no component, no JS.

## Optional

- [README](README.md): installation, setup, package layout.
